name: Netspeed
summary: Canberra ISP founded c.1994; acquired Velocity Internet (2010) and Apex Telecom (2012); both NetSpeed and Velocity traded under ByteCard Pty Ltd. Retired from retail internet c.Jan 2024; website reduced to webmail-only while sibling brand Velocity continued.

events.details: NetSpeed Communications established in Canberra. Legal entity later operated as ByteCard Pty Ltd (ACN 052 315 812); trading name 'Netspeed Internet Communications' registered Sep 2005.
Retail netspeed.com.au live 17 Sep 2024; replaced by a webmail-only portal by 15 Oct 2024 (Wayback captures). Earlier 'by 30 Jan 2024' was mis-dated (capture misread).

ABR: ABN 49 052 315 812 Bytecard Pty Ltd, trading as Netspeed Internet Communications
In 2026 the domain is still a webmail-only page; owner ByteCard continues via the Velocity brand.
Full retail site still live 17 Sep 2024 - three days after the brief's 'by Jan 2024' claim's terminus; the retirement is later than stated.
